notes.title: Release of version 2.1: Urban chronicles
notes.content:
The key features of this update include:

* Increased number of characters for potential interaction and various opportunities
* Addition of street events in Greymarsh
* Added illustrations
* Language overhaul
* Several bug fixes

notes.title: Greymarsh reimagined
notes.content:
This is a major update. Key features:

* Visuals that bring locations, people and opponents to life
* Music and atmospheric sound
* A fast travel mechanism
* Info about story progression
* Steam achievements
* Tutorial to help new players get started quickly
* Bug fixes, large and small

The overall aim is a smoother and more immersive gaming experience.
